score_interpretation: Rule-based ranking score, not a win probability.
missing_data_policy: null_and_renormalize_available_components; hard gates still block active status.
correlation_method: absolute Pearson correlation of aligned daily close-to-close returns; penalty is transparent and separate from raw score

fx_shortlist.note: Provisional research shortlist. The ShowMyTrades no-key calendar covers eight major FX currencies and supplies consensus/actuals; XOOMAR supplements US agency schedules. ECB is a daily reference cross-check, not an intraday price feed. Expert scoring requires matched, independently audited closed trades.
